IS 8252 : Part 6 : 1976 : Environmental Tests for Aircraft Equipment - Part VI : WaterproofnessUDC 629.13.05 : 620.193.2TED 14Reaffirmed 20211. ScopeSpecifies tests for waterproofness applicable to equipment in aircraft which is required to perate when exposed to conditions where water is sprayed on it, as in driving rain, or where water is lripping on it, such as condensation falling from an adjacent aircraft structure. 4 waterproofness.
